title: Redbelly, where it matters
logline: What Redbelly does and why it matters, in everyday language.

scenes.visual: A phone sends money to Mum. A paper plane flies off and a red tick lands: Sent, 00:02.
The same phone tries to buy into a fund. The button turns into Pending while a desk calendar flips from Monday to Wednesday.
Four tiles slam in on the beat: a form, an ID card, a row of people and an hourglass. A deal crawls along a tangled path between them.

lines: Redbelly is built to change that.

scenes.visual: The tangled path pulls tight into one red line, folds into the hexagon of the Redbelly isotype, and the official logo resolves with a light ripple.
A honeycomb network grows around the Redbelly isotype, with a bond, a loan, a fund, a building and a leaf in the cells around it.
The five asset hexagons glide into a row and each is named on the beat.
A paper ownership certificate is scanned into a glowing digital card, and three rule chips slide out of it.
Three numbered hexagons: Verified, Built-in rules, Final. The camera dives into the first.

headline: Everyone is
verified.
body: Every person proves who they are

scenes.visual: A person in a hexagon gets a face check against a passport; a red verified badge pops on and the passport details blur behind a lock.
A property card carries its own rules. A verified buyer passes and is approved; an unverified buyer bounces off the boundary.
Money and a property card swap places in one move, lock, and a ring closes into a FINAL stamp. An undo arrow is struck out.
A graph of states lights up, every node ticked in turn, ending on a Proven correct seal. University of Sydney and CSIRO chips sit above.
An A$ coin from the central bank streams into three networks: two private, one public, Redbelly, which lights up.
Three cards: a paper stack that thins out, middlemen who fade away, and a clock that never stops (24/7).

lines: fast, safe, and by the rules.

The official Redbelly logo with the three ideas underneath and the web address.

claims.text: Buying into a fund can still take days to settle.

evidence.quote: Every subscription, redemption and transfer remains unsettled for two business days in listed funds, and often longer in private assets.

claims.text: Today that involves paperwork, repeated ID checks, middlemen and waiting.

evidence.quote: Investor eligibility, holder limits and transfer restrictions are typically managed through spreadsheets, emails and manual sign-offs.
Reusable client identity and KYC credentials streamline onboarding and reduce duplication
Lower intermediaries and automate issuance, settlement and compliance
Every subscription, redemption and transfer remains unsettled for two business days in listed funds, and often longer in private assets.

claims.text: Redbelly is built to issue, manage and trade assets digitally, with compliance built in.

evidence.quote: Redbelly provides the infrastructure to issue, manage, and distribute regulated digital financial assets to a global investor base.
Asset issuers can issue and distribute products globally, with compliance built into the infrastructure

evidence.quote: Redbelly is a public network

claims.text: Ownership is recorded digitally, with the asset's rules programmed in.

evidence.quote: Tokenisation records ownership of financial products and services as digital tokens, and lets you program the rules of the asset.

claims.text: Everyone taking part must prove who they are before they can act on the network.

evidence.quote: all network participants MUST prove they are who they say they are before gaining access

claims.text: People prove their identity with a passport, checked with biometrics.

evidence.quote: prove they possess a valid photo identity document (passport) which is verified via biometric checks

claims.text: Personal details stay protected.

evidence.quote: Participants verify their identities, but their privacy remains protected through zero-knowledge proofs.
minimises their data exposure

claims.text: Each asset sets who is allowed to hold it, and this is enforced at the point of trade.

evidence.quote: defined investor eligibility, enforced at the point of trade
only users that can prove they meet the criteria can interact with a smart contract's functions

claims.text: Trades that break the rules do not go through.

evidence.quote: Trades that fail a check do not proceed
defined investor eligibility, enforced at the point of trade

claims.text: Money and ownership change hands in a single step.

evidence.quote: Its deterministic consensus unifies payments and asset ledgers into a single system
cash and units are exchanged in a single step
Both the tokenised bond and the wCBDC were issued on to the same network.

claims.text: Transactions are final within seconds and cannot be reversed.

evidence.quote: transactions can be deterministically finalised in a matter of seconds
Deterministic finality ensures transactions are confirmed once and cannot be reversed
Deterministic finality settles a transaction in a single round, final the moment it completes.
